name: World Monster Fishing ADV
source:
After catching monster fish and publishing shocking reports from all over the world, the editor-in-chief of the extreme fishing magazine World Monster Graphic mysteriously disappears. 24 years later a new editor-in-chief takes the reins of the magazine trying to bring it back to its glory days.
